biggest_catch: The friend has a 90-day window to complete the requirements ($500/month direct deposit OR a funded consumer loan) - if they fail, NEITHER of you gets the $100.
catches: Both the referring and new member receive $100 once the new member qualifies and meets the requirements.
New member must open a qualifying share and checking account AND (a) set up a recurring direct deposit of at least $500/month, or (b) fund any Foothill consumer loan.
The direct deposit must hit the account before any incentive is paid; 90-day time frame to fulfill the requirement.
Career Supply Loan does not qualify; if the referred member fails any requirement, neither party gets the incentive.
No referral limit stated ('Refer as many new members as you like!').
Offer may end at any time; membership requires a regular share account with $5 minimum balance; must be 18+.
No tax language on the page (standard bonus treatment; not stated).

steps: Log in to Foothill Digital Banking and choose 'Refer a Friend' under Accounts.
Enter your friend's first and last name and email address.
Friend receives a unique referral code; they visit a branch or apply online with the code.
Friend opens a qualifying share + checking account and sets up $500+/month direct deposit (or funds a consumer loan) within 90 days.
timing: $100 deposited at a set date after the new member satisfies the requirements within the 90-day window.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $100 deposited at a set date after the new member satisfies the requirements within the 90-day window. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
